Flat high? It isn't RESISTANCE. ⚠️

Two tops at the exact same price look like a wall of sellers. On the profile it's the opposite: a poor high, no excess, no tail, no aggressive selling. The auction up there is unfinished, and the market usually comes back to finish it, running the stops of everyone who shorted the "double top".

1️⃣ Flat high with no excess = unfinished auction
2️⃣ Don't short a poor high just because it held twice
3️⃣ Expect price to come back and trade above it
